title: This Shark Stuns Fish With a Whip-Like Tail

scenes.text: This shark hunts by whipping fish with its tail.
Its tail is nearly half the length of its body.
Divers filmed it off the Philippines, whipping the tail over its head at schools of sardines.
One slap can stun several fish at once, sometimes as many as seven.
Then the shark simply eats them.
A tail that works like a weapon.
